refactor(daemon): the idle clock keys sessions by the checked SessionId, so its menu-idle turn names its session with no cast (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.snf)

The clock's records, pending counts, methods and deps take SessionId; the
verb context's clickLanded, closeIdleMenus and the renderer's closeIdle
pass it through. Every caller already held a checked id, so nothing parses
anew, and closeByTurn's cast and its parse-dont-validate exception go. The
verb layer's wider sid: string stays: it reads ids, and SessionId narrows
to string there.

feat(renderer): a click is a turn through answer, and its output carries what its act moved (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8se) (#717)

* feat(renderer): a click is a turn through answer, and its output carries what its act moved (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8se)

A click that runs a verb is now one `click` turn of the main renderer, and
the idle clock's close of a session's menus is a `menu-idle` turn. Every
verb still acts in place, through the verb table over the daemon's verb
context, now reached as the renderer's own port. So a turn's output reads
the subscriptions once the act has landed (its commit and its view's
follow), which 8e9 needs once the host learns of a moved run only from an
output.

The host keeps the session checkpoint, the status row's resolution and its
opener; a turn's throw is the click's reply by its class, as before. A click
in flight holds its session against the collector's sweep, and its release
names the session as a request does. The idle close turns a turn that threw
back into a rejection, so the clock waits a timeout before retrying and
writes its one line.

* fix(renderer): a turn that threw still names its views, and the host refuses every effect a turn answering no request returns (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8se)

A click can commit and follow its view before a later step throws, so a
thrown turn carries the open views' subscriptions and the host takes them.
Every effect of a turn other than a request is refused through the host's
one path, which replaces the config turn's own refusal. Only a live session
is held by a click: a retiring record goes once its retire settles.

* fix(renderer): the host records what it knows of a click before parsing it, and stamps a refusal by its own clock (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8se)

A click whose session segment does not decode is refused before its turn
runs, so its verb and session are noted by the host ahead of the parse and
the click turn records only what it learns. The idle clock's click brackets
belong to the main renderer's parts, not the draw's. A refused effect's
effect-done carries the instant the host refused it, through instantAt.
